Vessel attacked off Oman; one Indian national missing, ten rescued

A commercial vessel carrying Indian crew was attacked off the coast of Oman. The Indian Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) confirmed that ten Indian nationals were rescued, but one remains missing. The MEA has described the continuing attacks on commercial shipping in the region as "deeply worrisome."
